9: # AI Content Pipeline
10: 
11: Build multi-step content creation pipelines via [inference.sh](https://inference.sh) CLI.
12: 
13: ![AI Content Pipeline](https://cloud.inference.sh/app/files/u/4mg21r6ta37mpaz6ktzwtt8krr/01kg06qgcg105rh6y1kvxm4wvm.png)
14: 
15: ## Quick Start
16: 
17: > Requires inference.sh CLI (`belt`). [Install instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inference-sh/skills/refs/heads/main/cli-install.md)
18: 
19: ```bash
20: belt login
21: 
22: # Simple pipeline: Generate image -> Animate to video
23: belt app run falai/flux-dev --input '{"prompt": "portrait of a woman smiling"}' > image.json
24: belt app run falai/wan-2-5 --input '{"image_url": "<url-from-previous>"}'
25: ```
26: 
27: 
28: ## Pipeline Patterns
29: 
30: ### Pattern 1: Image -> Video -> Audio
31: 
32: ```
33: [FLUX Image] -> [Wan 2.5 Video] -> [Foley Sound]
34: ```
35: 
36: ### Pattern 2: Script -> Speech -> Avatar
37: 
38: ```
39: [LLM Script] -> [Kokoro TTS] -> [OmniHuman Avatar]
40: ```
41: 
42: ### Pattern 3: Research -> Content -> Distribution
43: 
44: ```
45: [Tavily Search] -> [Claude Summary] -> [FLUX Visual] -> [Twitter Post]
46: ```
47: 
48: ## Complete Workflows
49: 
50: ### YouTube Short Pipeline
51: 
52: Create a complete short-form video from a topic.
53: 
54: ```bash
55: # 1. Generate script with Claude
56: belt app run openrouter/claude-sonnet-45 --input '{
57:   "prompt": "Write a 30-second script about the future of AI. Make it engaging and conversational. Just the script, no stage directions."
58: }' > script.json
59: 
60: # 2. Generate voiceover with Kokoro
61: belt app run infsh/kokoro-tts --input '{
62:   "prompt": "<script-text>",
63:   "voice": "af_sarah"
64: }' > voice.json
65: 
66: # 3. Generate background image with FLUX
67: belt app run falai/flux-dev --input '{
68:   "prompt": "Futuristic city skyline at sunset, cyberpunk aesthetic, 4K wallpaper"
69: }' > background.json
70: 
71: # 4. Animate image to video with Wan
72: belt app run falai/wan-2-5 --input '{
73:   "image_url": "<background-url>",
74:   "prompt": "slow camera pan across cityscape, subtle movement"
75: }' > video.json
76: 
77: # 5. Add captions (manually or with another tool)
78: 
79: # 6. Merge video with audio
80: belt app run infsh/media-merger --input '{
81:   "video_url": "<video-url>",
82:   "audio_url": "<voice-url>"
83: }'
84: ```
85: 
86: ### Talking Head Video Pipeline
87: 
88: Create an AI avatar presenting content.
89: 
90: ```bash
91: # 1. Write the script
92: belt app run openrouter/claude-sonnet-45 --input '{
93:   "prompt": "Write a 1-minute explainer script about quantum computing for beginners."
94: }' > script.json
95: 
96: # 2. Generate speech
97: belt app run infsh/kokoro-tts --input '{
98:   "prompt": "<script>",
99:   "voice": "am_michael"
100: }' > speech.json
101: 
102: # 3. Generate or use a portrait image
103: belt app run falai/flux-dev --input '{
104:   "prompt": "Professional headshot of a friendly tech presenter, neutral background, looking at camera"
105: }' > portrait.json
106: 
107: # 4. Create talking head video
108: belt app run bytedance/omnihuman-1-5 --input '{
109:   "image_url": "<portrait-url>",
110:   "audio_url": "<speech-url>"
111: }' > talking_head.json
112: ```
113: 
114: ### Product Demo Pipeline
115: 
116: Create a product showcase video.
117: 
118: ```bash
119: # 1. Generate product image
120: belt app run falai/flux-dev --input '{
121:   "prompt": "Sleek wireless earbuds on white surface, studio lighting, product photography"
122: }' > product.json
123: 
124: # 2. Animate product reveal
125: belt app run falai/wan-2-5 --input '{
126:   "image_url": "<product-url>",
127:   "prompt": "slow 360 rotation, smooth motion"
128: }' > product_video.json
129: 
130: # 3. Upscale video quality
131: belt app run falai/topaz-video-upscaler --input '{
132:   "video_url": "<product-video-url>"
133: }' > upscaled.json
134: 
135: # 4. Add background music
136: belt app run infsh/media-merger --input '{
137:   "video_url": "<upscaled-url>",
138:   "audio_url": "https://your-music.mp3",
139:   "audio_volume": 0.3
140: }'
141: ```
142: 
143: ### Blog to Video Pipeline
144: 
145: Convert written content to video format.
146: 
147: ```bash
148: # 1. Summarize blog post
149: belt app run openrouter/claude-haiku-45 --input '{
150:   "prompt": "Summarize this blog post into 5 key points for a video script: <blog-content>"
151: }' > summary.json
152: 
153: # 2. Generate images for each point
154: for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
155:   belt app run falai/flux-dev --input "{
156:     \"prompt\": \"Visual representing point $i: <point-text>\"
157:   }" > "image_$i.json"
158: done
159: 
160: # 3. Animate each image
161: for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
162:   belt app run falai/wan-2-5 --input "{
163:     \"image_url\": \"<image-$i-url>\"
164:   }" > "video_$i.json"
165: done
166: 
167: # 4. Generate voiceover
168: belt app run infsh/kokoro-tts --input '{
169:   "prompt": "<full-script>",
170:   "voice": "bf_emma"
171: }' > narration.json
172: 
173: # 5. Merge all clips
174: belt app run infsh/media-merger --input '{
175:   "videos": ["<video1>", "<video2>", "<video3>", "<video4>", "<video5>"],
176:   "audio_url": "<narration-url>",
177:   "transition": "crossfade"
178: }'
179: ```
180: 
181: ## Pipeline Building Blocks
182: 
183: ### Content Generation
184: 
185: | Step | App | Purpose |
186: |------|-----|---------|
187: | Script | `openrouter/claude-sonnet-45` | Write content |
188: | Research | `tavily/search-assistant` | Gather information |
189: | Summary | `openrouter/claude-haiku-45` | Condense content |
190: 
191: ### Visual Assets
192: 
193: | Step | App | Purpose |
194: |------|-----|---------|
195: | Image | `falai/flux-dev` | Generate images |
196: | Image | `google/imagen-3` | Alternative image gen |
197: | Upscale | `falai/topaz-image-upscaler` | Enhance quality |
198: 
199: ### Animation
200: 
201: | Step | App | Purpose |
202: |------|-----|---------|
203: | I2V | `falai/wan-2-5` | Animate images |
204: | T2V | `google/veo-3-1-fast` | Generate from text |
205: | Avatar | `bytedance/omnihuman-1-5` | Talking heads |
206: 
207: ### Audio
208: 
209: | Step | App | Purpose |
210: |------|-----|---------|
211: | TTS | `infsh/kokoro-tts` | Voice narration |
212: | Music | `infsh/ai-music` | Background music |
213: | Foley | `infsh/hunyuanvideo-foley` | Sound effects |
214: 
215: ### Post-Production
216: 
217: | Step | App | Purpose |
218: |------|-----|---------|
219: | Upscale | `falai/topaz-video-upscaler` | Enhance video |
220: | Merge | `infsh/media-merger` | Combine media |
221: | Caption | `infsh/caption-video` | Add subtitles |
222: 
223: ## Best Practices
224: 
225: 1. **Plan the pipeline first** - Map out each step before running
226: 2. **Save intermediate results** - Store outputs for iteration
227: 3. **Use appropriate quality** - Fast models for drafts, quality for finals
228: 4. **Match resolutions** - Keep consistent aspect ratios throughout
229: 5. **Test each step** - Verify outputs before proceeding
